verdicts.rationale: Both are Walton, 'Mimesis as Make-Believe', 1990, Harvard University Press. b truncates the subtitle; differing ISBNs are just hardback vs paperback of the same book.
Both are Walton, 'Mimesis as Make-Believe', 1990, Harvard University Press; b truncates the subtitle. Same book.

b is a corrupted/merged entry: title 'Mimesis as Make-Believe (Cambridge, Mass' but journal/volume/pages point to Walton's 2002 JAAC paper 'Depiction, Perception, and Imagination' (vol 60, 27-40). It conflates the 1990 book with a distinct 2002 article, so it is not cleanly the same work.
b has 'Memesis' (typo for Mimesis) but identical subtitle 'On the Foundations of the Representational Arts', Walton, 1990, Harvard University Press. Same book.
